FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum

  AND TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('brickwork house', 'condominium', 'apartment')
  AND TRIM(LOWER(a.cablestatus)) IN ('available', 'yes', 'y');
